primary_contract: Rust CI, pre-commit, and supply-chain quality-gate policy

included: Rust formatting, clippy, and test gate expectations.
Python/docs/Rust quality-gate alignment across workflow and local guidance.
Supply-chain hardening guidance for audit, deny, SBOM, signing, attestations, dependency automation, and release policy.

excluded: Guaranteeing every CI-side cargo audit, cargo deny, SBOM, or signing provider has run in the current local workspace.

gap_register.description: Local fmt and clippy evidence can pass, but audit/deny/SBOM/signing confidence requires CI-side tool availability and release workflow evidence.
Full `cargo test --workspace` currently reaches a local `nwau-py` dynamic Python linkage blocker when `libpython3.13.dylib` is unavailable; binding stabilization owns that environment-specific proof.
